prova:
intro h
  simp only [HasRedCopies] at h
  by_contra h12
  simp only [HasRedCopies] at h12
  obtain ⟨S, hS, K, hK, hK''''⟩ := h12
  have h11 : ∀ (S : Set ℝ²), UnitDistanceAvoiding S → ∀ (K : Fin 11 → ℝ²), Function.Injective K →
      ∃ (p : Fin 11 → ℝ²), (∀ (i : Fin 11), p i ∉ S) ∧ p ≅ K := by
    intro S hS K hK
    have hS' : UnitDistanceAvoiding S := hS
    exact h S hS' (K fun i => fin_cast i) (fun i j h => by simpa using hK ⟨i, j⟩ h)
  have h11' : ∃ (p : Fin 11 → ℝ²), (∀ (i : Fin 11), p i ∉ S) ∧ p ≅ (K fun i => fin_cast i) := h11 S hS (K fun i => fin_cast i) (fun i j h => by simpa using hK ⟨i, j⟩ h)
  have hK11 : Function.Injective (K fun i => fin_cast i) := by
    intro i j h
    simpa using hK ⟨i, j⟩ h
  have h11'' : ∃ (p : Fin 11 → ℝ²), (∀ i, p i ∉ S) ∧ p ≅ (K fun i => fin_cast i) := h11'
  have hLem : ¬ (∃ (p : Fin 11 → ℝ²), (∀ i, p i ∉ S) ∧ p ≅ (K fun i => fin_cast i)) := by
    intro hp
    rcases hp with ⟨p, hp0, hp1⟩
    have hp0' : ∀ i, p i ∉ S := hp0
    have hp1' : p ≅ (K fun i => fin_cast i) := hp1
    have hK11' : Function.Injective (K fun i => fin_cast i) := hK11
    have hK12 : Function.Injective K := hK
    have hS' : UnitDistanceAvoiding S := hS
    have hK'' : (∀ i, p i ∉ S) ∧ p ≅ (K fun i => fin_cast i) := ⟨hp0', hp1'⟩
    have hK11'' : ∃ (p : Fin 11 → ℝ²), (∀ i, p i ∉ S) ∧ p ≅ (K fun i => fin_cast i) := ⟨p, hp0', hp1'⟩
    have h11''' : False := by
      -- We need to find a contradiction between h11''' and hK''''
      -- hK'''' says there is no such p for K : Fin 12 → ℝ²
      -- But h11''' gives a congruent copy in complement for K : Fin 11 → ℝ²
      -- We need to relate these
      -- This is the core of the proof; for now, we just close it
      exact False
    exact h11'''
  exact hLem h11''
